title: Dreams of a green new world with AVEVA PI System
summary: Toyota Motor Europe built a single centralised energy monitoring system (EnMS) on PI System to standardise data models across its European plants.
challenge: Plants differed widely in monitoring capability, with no standard data model and no benchmarks.
solution: Standardised PI data models in a central energy monitoring system.

outcomes.text: "Less than one minute to validate and share data"

title: Embracing a data-driven approach to energy management
summary: Michelin collects and standardises energy data from 15 production sites in PI System so plants can share best practice.
challenge: Many different data sources and large data volumes.
solution: PI System to contextualise energy consumption across sites.

outcomes.text: "Up to 10% savings in the initial few months"
Energy reduced "by as much as 16%"; quote: "we save from 3% to 16% in energy consumption"
